title: Beevibe Architecture Deep Research Follow-up Questions
description: Sharper sub-decision questions derived from comparison-matrix axis variance. Each follow-up names a high-spread axis, a question that splits the options on that axis, and a pre-filled `adr deep-research` command the user can paste to chase it.

axis.description: Axis id from the comparison matrix (e.g. 'deployment_model', 'pricing_model').

spread_score.description: Variance score across candidate verdicts on this axis. Higher = the axis genuinely discriminates.

question.description: Sharp 1-sentence sub-decision question that splits the options on this axis.

suggested_command.description: Pre-filled `adr deep-research` command the user can paste to chase the sub-decision.
